generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Three-row SUV, 92 kWh or 123 kWh usable (the page also mentions 106 kWh; inconsistent), 300 kW dual motor. North American sales from mid-2022 per Wikipedia, MY2024 in EPA and NRCan. No year-by-year hardware change documented. Confidence: low (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/VinFast_VF_9
